verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a three-board PCB architecture and supplies the first board design for review.
The client defines the architectural roles of the remaining boards as an ESP32-S3 main board and a sensor-connector board.
The client specifies the main board's functional allocation and confirms that sensors and power management reside on other boards.
The client adds a cost-reduced integrated-board variant that retains device functionality while eliminating interboard connectors; administrative price and milestone details are not encoded.
